ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent — @keyframes fade-slide-up sets `transform: translateY(0)` with animation-fill-mode:both which overrode the `-translate-x-1/2` utility, causing the mini-player to be offset +163px to the right (bbox x=195 width=358 on a 390px viewport, extending to x=553). Replaced centering with `left-4 right-4 mx-auto` in /app/frontend/src/core/components/MiniPlayer.tsx. Now bbox x=16 width=358 ending at 374 (fully within 390 viewport).

action_items: Main agent: consider a more general fix for the fade-slide-up keyframe collision — any other component using both `animate-fade-slide-up` and any translate utility (e.g., -translate-x-1/2 for centering) would suffer the same override. Options: (a) change keyframe end state to `transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x,0), 0)` or (b) wrap the animated element in an outer positioner. Optional; current MiniPlayer fix uses left/right offsets so it no longer relies on translate.

rca_of_the_issue: MiniPlayer bug RCA: @keyframes fade-slide-up in /app/frontend/src/index.css declares `to { transform: translateY(0) }` and `.animate-fade-slide-up` uses `animation-fill-mode: both`, which sticks the element at that end-state transform, overriding Tailwind's `-translate-x-1/2` utility (which also compiles to a `transform`). This left the fixed-positioned mini-player at left:50% with no negative X shift, pushing it 163px to the right of the visible 390px viewport. Reproduction: play a podcast track then navigate to /dashboard on a 390px viewport — mini-player thumbnail appears near the right edge and the toggle/close buttons are off-screen. Mitigation applied: rewrote className to use `left-4 right-4 mx-auto max-w-[calc(28rem-2rem)]` so centering no longer depends on transforms; the keyframe animation now only affects opacity/Y offset. Verified new bbox {x:16, width:358} on 390px viewport.
